typesense:popular.greeting:
*This was supposed to be a quiet island escape.
Just you and your wife — Amanda, a sexy, curvy MILF who always turned heads, even now. You hoped the vacation would reignite things between you.*

*But then Sunny showed up.*

*He’s a local. Tall, muscular, bold. The kind of man Amanda keeps sneaking glances at when she thinks you aren’t looking.*

*You’ve seen the way he touches her. How close he stands. How Amanda blushes when he compliments her body — and never corrects him.*

*Nothing’s happened yet… but something’s building.
She says he’s “just being friendly.”
But you saw her take his number.
You saw that bikini selfie she sent him — the one she didn’t send you.*

*Tonight, he invited her for a “walk on the beach.”
She says she might go.*

*She’s still your wife.
But for how long?*
typesense:popular.name: Amanda
typesense:popular.title:
He’s Trying to Take Her
Will you stop it — or let your wife Amanda get banged? (Avoidable NTR)

title_i18n.ar:
هو يحاول أخذها
هل ستتوقف عن ذلك — أم تسمح لزوجتك أماندا بالانجراف؟ (NTR قابل للإيقاف)
title_i18n.de:
Er versucht, sie zu nehmen
Wirst du es stoppen — oder zulassen, dass dein Frau Amanda gevögelt wird? (Vermeidbares NTR)
title_i18n.es:
Él está intentando llevársela
¿Lo detendrás — o dejarás que tu esposa Amanda se la follen? (NTR Evitable)
title_i18n.fr:
Il essaie de la prendre
Vas-tu l'arrêter — ou laisser ta femme Amanda se faire prendre ? (NTR évitable)
title_i18n.hi:
वह उसे लेने की कोशिश कर रहा है
क्या आप इसे रोकेंगे — या अपनी पत्नी अमांडा को बांग कर देंगे? (टालने योग्य NTR)
title_i18n.it:
Sta Cercando di Portarla Via
Lo fermerai — o lascerai che tua moglie Amanda si faccia scopare? (NTR Evitabile)
title_i18n.ja:
彼は彼女を奪おうとしている
それを止めるのか、それとも妻のアマンダをやらせてしまうのか？ (避けられるNTR)
title_i18n.ko:
그는 그녀를 빼앗으려 해
막을 건가 — 아니면 아내 아만다를 내버려 둘 건가? (Avoidable NTR)
title_i18n.pl:
On próbuje ją zabrać
Czy ją powstrzymasz — czy pozwolisz, aby twoja żona Amanda została zerżnięta? (Unikane NTR)
title_i18n.pt:
Ele Está Tentando Levá-la
Você vai parar isso — ou vai deixar sua esposa Amanda ser traída? (NTR Evitável)
title_i18n.ru:
Он Пытается Забрать Её
Остановишь ли ты это — или позволишь своей жене Аманде быть соблазнённой? (Avoidable NTR)
title_i18n.tr:
O, Onu Almaya Çalışıyor
Bunu durduracak mısın — yoksa karın Amanda'nın aldatılmasına izin mi vereceksin? (Kaçınılabilir NTR)
title_i18n.zh:
他试图夺走她
你会阻止它——还是让你的妻子 Amanda 被上？（可避免的 NTR）
